description: HYPERS-Global represents solar-wind interactions with planetary magnetospheres using kinetic ions and fluid electrons. Its parallel hybrid calculations address plasma processes whose ion-scale behaviour is not resolved by fluid magnetohydrodynamics alone. The resource is documented by Space Science Institute, Boulder, CO. The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere, Local Physics; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Distance normalisation and computational scaling affect the interpretation of an Earth simulation. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
